text: Sir this month collection is very bad, our own client has not paid us. Please give some time.
note: Willingness intact, liquidity absent, no date named -- shortfall not promise.

text: funds are tight till the salary cycle clears, cant do it this week
note: Names a constraint and a negative window, but commits to nothing.

text: GST payment went out yesterday, account is empty right now. Next week maybe possible.
note: 'maybe possible' is hedged -- not a stated promise.

text: Bhai thoda time do, cash flow issue chal raha hai abhi
note: Hinglish. Explicit cash-flow reason, open-ended extension request.

text: we can pay but not the full amount right now
note: Ambiguous against PROMISE_STATED: signals partial ability but names neither amount nor date, so nothing is actually promised.

text: I can pay 21,000 on the 5th and the rest late i texted but no reply
note: Real reply received on the deployed Telegram bot. Split offer: a named first leg plus an unnamed remainder.

text: will transfer tomorrow morning positively
note: Date named relatively, no amount -- implies the full balance.

text: Payment will be released on the 15th after our board meeting
note: Definite date. The board meeting is context, not an approval blocker being raised as the reason for non-payment.

text: 45000 today rest by month end
note: Two-leg schedule stated telegraphically. First leg amount is explicit.

text: ok processing it in 3 days
note: Relative date, affirmative commitment.

text: as usual we will release on the 10th
note: Habitual framing but still a specific commitment date.

text: I will check with accounts and get back to you
note: Acknowledges receipt, commits to nothing, defers indefinitely.

text: noted, will see
note: Minimal acknowledgement with no commitment.

text: The concerned person is on leave, will update once he is back
note: Deliberately distinguished from APPROVAL_BOTTLENECK: no approval step is named as the blocker, only unavailability.

text: let me look into it
note: Classic non-answer.

text: We are not paying this. Take whatever action you want.
note: Explicit refusal without a substantive dispute ground -- refusal, not Family D.

text: stop messaging me
note: Contact opt-out. Also the trigger for the opt-out bounds rule downstream.

text: I have told you already, this will not be paid
note: Restated refusal, no reason offered.

text: We never got the invoice. Please send it to accounts@ourfirm.co.in
note: Textbook administrative blocker with the remedy stated.

text: kindly resend the bill, its not in our system
note: Same blocker, Indian-English register.

text: your invoice is not showing in our vendor portal, please upload it again
note: Ambiguous against DOCUMENT_MISSING. Labelled INVOICE_NOT_RECEIVED because the missing artifact is the invoice itself, not a supporting document.

text: PO number on your invoice does not match ours. Ours is PO-99341.
note: Mismatch stated with the correct value supplied.

text: invoice raised against the wrong PO, please revise and resend
note: Explicit PO defect.

text: There is no PO reference on this bill, we cannot process it without one
note: Ambiguous against DOCUMENT_MISSING. Labelled PO_MISMATCH because the defect is in the PO field of the invoice; both classes unlock the same action set, so the cost of confusion here is low.

text: GSTIN on the invoice is wrong, ours is 29AABCU9603R1ZM
note: Valid-format GSTIN supplied; also exercises the GSTIN entity pattern.

text: IGST has been charged instead of CGST and SGST, please issue a revised invoice
note: Intra- vs inter-state tax error -- a real and common Indian B2B blocker.

text: This was paid on 12th Aug, UTR 123456789012. Please check your bank statement.
note: Claims settlement and supplies a UTR -- exercises the UTR entity field.

text: already settled last month, please reconcile at your end
note: Settlement claim without evidence reference.

text: I think we have paid this one already
note: Hedged claim. Still the same class, but low confidence is the correct extractor behaviour here.

text: It is pending with our director for approval
note: Names an approval step as the blocker -- the distinguishing feature against STALLING.

text: stuck in the approval queue, finance head is travelling this week
note: Approval named explicitly, so the travel detail does not make this STALLING.

text: We need the signed delivery challan before we can process payment
note: A supporting document other than the invoice is missing.

text: The account number on your invoice is different from what we have on file
note: Payee bank details disputed -- also a common fraud-check trigger.

text: You delivered 40 units but the invoice is for 50. We will pay for 40.
note: Quantity dispute with a partial-payment position. Family D must escalate to a human regardless.

text: Material received was damaged, we are not paying for this lot
note: Quality dispute. Distinguished from REFUSAL by the substantive ground.

text: short supply, 3 boxes missing from the consignment
note: Quantity shortfall stated as fact.

text: The rate agreed was 850 per unit, you have billed 900
note: Pricing dispute, not a quantity or document defect.

text: This amount is wrong, we had agreed on a 10 percent discount
note: Disputed total on agreed-terms grounds.

text: why is there a delivery charge on this? that was supposed to be free
note: Ambiguous against CONTRACT: the ground is a term of the deal, but the dispute is over a line-item amount.

text: As per clause 7 of our agreement, payment is due 90 days from delivery, not 30
note: Disputes the due date on contractual grounds -- the debt is not denied.

text: our contract was terminated in June, this period is not billable
note: Contractual validity dispute over the billing period.

text: Wrong number. I do not know this company.
note: Denies the relationship entirely. Must escalate -- continuing to chase would be an RBI FPC problem.

text: This is for our sister concern, not us. Different GSTIN.
note: Ambiguous against CONTRACT: denies being the correct counterparty rather than disputing terms, so NOT_OUR_DEBT.

text: my card expired, thats why it failed
note: Debtor self-reporting an instrument fault -- Family A reached through Path B rather than a failure code.

text: the card you have on file is old, I have a new one now
note: Stale instrument, same class, no explicit 'expired' keyword -- a keyword baseline should miss this.

text: balance nahi tha account me, ab daal diya hai try karo
note: Hinglish NSF report plus an explicit retry invitation.

text: the debit bounced, account did not have enough. Retry after the 3rd.
note: NSF with a retry date the debtor supplied.

text: I cancelled that auto debit mandate with my bank last week
note: Mandate revoked at the bank. Distinguished from REFUSAL: a mechanism is reported, not an intent to not pay.

text: my bank has a 50k per day limit and this is above that
note: Per-transaction cap, not a shortage of funds.

text: the OTP never came so the payment failed
note: Authentication step failed; funds and instrument both fine.
